RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 15

An all-female panel is not evidence of bias, just as an all-male panel does not inherently indicate discrimination. Public broadcasters currently prioritize digital transformation; eight years of relevant experience combined with strong digital expertise can legitimately outweigh greater general seniority. 

Furthermore, two weeks is a standard administrative turnaround time for detailed written feedback. Raising gender without concrete evidence—such as inappropriate interview remarks or documented procedural breaches—will appear unfounded, damage your professional standing, and close doors to future opportunities. 

Instead, send a polite follow-up requesting your feedback, focusing strictly on competencies, digital strategy, and how you can position yourself for future editorial roles.
